login.title: Sign in
login.heroBody: Sign in to continue booking, reviewing consultations, and managing the clinical network.
login.pageSubheading: Sign in to your Global Health account

register.title: Create account
register.metaDescription: Create a patient account for Global Health.
register.heroBody: Book consultations, receive prescriptions, and manage your family's health — all in one place.
register.pageSubheading: Free to join. Confirmations and receipts go to your email.
register.consentPrefix: By continuing, you agree to our
register.passwordHelp: Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers.
register.termsNotice: By creating an account, you agree to use this platform for patient booking and consultation management.

forgotPassword.metaDescription: Request a password reset for your Global Health account.
forgotPassword.heroBody: We accept the reset request without revealing whether an email is registered.
forgotPassword.pageSubheading: Enter your email and we will accept the reset request. If the account exists, instructions will be sent when email delivery is enabled.
forgotPassword.securityNote: For security, we never confirm whether an email is registered.

verifyEmail.heroBody: Verification keeps patient records and booking updates tied to the right email address.
verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.body: Click the link in the email we sent you. If you didn’t get it, check spam or sign in to request a new one.
verifyEmail.failedBody: The link may be expired or already used. Sign in and request a new one.

resetPassword.inviteTitle: Welcome to Global Health — set your password
resetPassword.inviteSubtitle: Pick a password at least 8 characters long. We’ll sign you in and drop you on your doctor dashboard.
resetPassword.resetSubtitle: Pick a password at least 8 characters long.
resetPassword.noToken: This page needs a {kind} token. Open the link from the email we sent you.
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
resetPassword.inviteSuccess: Password set. Taking you to the doctor portal…
resetPassword.resetSuccess: Password updated. You can sign in now.

corporateInvite.body: Activate your membership to unlock corporate health benefits — consultations, discounts, and your digital benefit card.
corporateInvite.invalidAsk: Ask your company admin to send a new invitation.
corporateInvite.linkInvalid: This invitation link is not valid.
corporateInvite.invitedBy: {company} invited you to join their corporate health plan
corporateInvite.existingNote: An account already exists for this email — enter its password to link your corporate membership.
corporateInvite.healthConsent: I consent to the processing of my health data for the delivery of care, as described in the Privacy Policy.
corporateInvite.consentError: Please accept all three consents to continue.
corporateInvite.activateError: Could not activate your membership. Try again.
corporateInvite.backendError: Backend is unavailable — try again in a moment.
